title: AiVanceCareerEvent
description: Reactive event envelope for the AiVance Career Event Bus, enabling asynchronous decoupling, event-driven state synchronization, and audit logging across Android, Web, Extension, and CLI runtimes.

eventId.description: Globally unique identifier for this event instance (UUID v4)

eventType.description: Domain-scoped event topic name in dot-notation format

timestamp.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when the event occurred

correlationId.description: Causality tracking ID linking multi-step asynchronous reactive flows

schemaVersion.description: Version of the event bus specification

payload.description: Domain entity or state delta payload associated with this event

metadata.description: Contextual execution metadata (e.g., user ID, client runtime, session tokens)
